summary.text: Jason Ballard is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 42, which covers Giles County, parts of Montgomery and Pulaski counties, and the City of Radford.
Jason Ballard has been a member since 2022.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Jason Ballard was born in Pearisburg, Virginia.
Jason Ballard studied at Concord University (B.A., B.S., 2001), West Virginia University College of Law (J.D., 2004), and The Judge Advocate General's School (LL.M., 2014).
Jason Ballard's listed occupation is lawyer.

The profile says Jason Ballard served in the U.S. Army from 2005 to 2016, including Operation Enduring Freedom in Afghanistan (2006-07) and Operation Iraqi Freedom in Iraq (2008-09), and has served in the U.S. Army Reserve since 2016.

Jason Ballard's listed memberships and affiliations include the Veterans of Foreign Wars, the Military Officers Association of America, the Night Stalker Association, the Virginia Trial Lawyers Association, and the West Virginia Lawyers Association.
The profile lists Catherine Teresa Gardill Ballard as Jason Ballard's spouse.
The House profile lists Jason Ballard's committee assignments as Courts of Justice, Transportation, and Labor and Commerce.
